articles.summary: SouthState Bank Corporation ("SouthState" or the "Company") (NYSE: SSB) today announced company executives will participate in the upcoming BancAnalysts Association of Boston (BAAB) Conference. SouthState's portion of the conference will begin at 8 a.m. ET on Friday, November 6, 2026. Executives from the bank will take part in a fireside chat-style discussion with the conference moderator. The discussion can be live-streamed in a listen-only format by visiting SouthState's Investor Relations site at https://southstatecorporation.q4ir.com/news/events-and-presentations/default.aspx during the event. A replay will also be made available on the Investor Relations page following the event. About SouthState Bank Corporation SouthState is a financial services company headquartered in Winter Haven, Florida. SouthState Bank, N.A., the company's nationally chartered bank subsidiary, provides consumer, commercial, mortgage and wealth management solutions to more than 1.8 million customers
articles.title: SouthState Bank Corporation to Participate in BancAnalysts Association of Boston Conference

articles.summary: SouthState Bank Corporation (NYSE: SSB) ("SouthState" or the "Company") announced today that it will release third quarter 2026 earnings results on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, after the market closes. Upon release, investors may access a copy of SouthState's earnings results at the Company's website at www.SouthStateBank.com under Investor Relations, News, News Market Data section. SouthState will host a conference call on Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. (ET) to discuss its third quarter 2026 results. Investors may call in (toll free) by dialing (833) 461-5787 within the US (host: Will Matthews, CFO). The conference ID number is 728284222. The numbers for international participants are listed at https://help.events.q4inc.com/eahc/international-dial-in-numbers . Participants may also pre-register for the conference by navigating to https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/728284222 . Access detail will be provided via email upon completion of registration.
